title: add benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v5: ingestion, normalization, and representative runners
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR implements version 5 of the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline: an end-to-end ingestion + normalization stage, first-class support for representative workload runners, and improved export artifacts for the benchmarking dashboard. Motivation: previous pipeline versions required manual post-processing to align runner outputs and produced inconsistent metrics across hardware profiles. This update standardizes event schemas, adds a lightweight normalization service to reconcile tokenization/latency fields, introduces representative workload runner templates (conversations, streaming, embeddings, reranking), and adds a daily aggregated report job that feeds the perf-canary dashboard. Changes are backward compatible: legacy CSV imports are supported via an adapter. Migration notes: operators can opt-in by flipping the config flag benchmark_lab.reporting_v5.enabled=false for a staged rollout; once validated, we will enable by default in the next release. Checklists: [x] ingestion + normalization implementation, [x] representative runners and templates, [x] automated aggregation job, [x] unit+integration tests for normalization, [x] docs and examples updated, [x] migration adapter for legacy outputs. Related: Linear ENG-4283, ENG-4399 for perf baselining, PM-912 for reporting product spec.

release_notes: Adds benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v5: standardized ingestion and normalization, representative workload runners, and daily aggregation exports to perf-canary dashboard. Backwards compatible with legacy CSV via adapter. Operators must opt-in during rollout via config flag. Expected to improve cross-hardware metric consistency and reduce manual post-processing.
related_incidents: INC-2026-014 (perf-regression: kv-cache mismatch) - this PR provides tooling to root-cause and normalize affected runs
